headline: Subcommittee to discuss budget recommendations for human rights education and community events.
summary: The Education and Rapid Response Subcommittee will review HRC membership status, discuss its history and purpose, and recommend budget items for education and community events related to human rights.
items: Review status of HRC members and quorum
Subcommittee members share history and purpose of subcommittee, including public statement template (June/October 2025)
Discuss and recommend budget for sharing resources to defend human rights and address human and civil rights violations
Discuss and recommend budget for hosting and supporting community events related to human and civil rights
location: Sohier Room, Beverly Public Library, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, Massachusetts 01915
